instruction: I often minimize VLC while listening to music, but I want the playback to pause automatically when I minimize the window. Can you enable the pause-when-minimized feature?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's pause-when-minimized feature. The evaluator checks if the 'qt-pause-minimized' setting in VLC configuration is set to 1 (enabled). This is similar to the original task which modifies VLC settings.

Expected value ('1') is semantically correct for enabling the pause-when-minimized feature

Complete coverage: instruction asks to enable feature, evaluator checks if feature is enabled
